name: loan-management-system
description: Loan Management System: borrower portal and operations dashboard (Next.js + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
